bullets.text: Q3 companywide CR 88.7 (87.5 YTD); PL CR improved 1.5 pts to 88.0; personal vehicle CR 88.7; personal property CR 72.8 (76.3 YTD); CL CR 92.6.
Companywide NPW +4% YOY as market growth turned slightly negative; PL NPW +4% to $19.9B; personal vehicle NPW +4%; CL NPW +9%, with core commercial auto a significant contributor.
Repurchased over $1.5B in common shares through 9M 2026, the highest annual level in over two decades; debt-to-capital ratio 19.6%; Q3 investment portfolio returned -1.5%.
Companywide PIF +6% YOY; PL renewal applications +9% and PIFs +6%; personal vehicle PIFs +7%; homeowners product new business applications +22% YOY.

Commercial auto industry excluding Progressive ran an estimated ~104 CR in 1H 2026 with mid-single-digit rate increases; Progressive expects its competitive position to strengthen as competitors raise rates.
Core commercial auto model 8.4 launched in two states; personal auto model 9.0 in 21 states (55% of PIFs); BOP expanded to California, totaling 47 states.
Quarterly media spend rose 18% YOY, generating efficient customer acquisition costs; continued investments made in agency growth incentives across most states and agencies.
PL vehicle non-acquisition expense ratio reduced 0.4 pts YTD versus the prior year through operating efficiency gains, while customer acquisition costs were elevated but still efficient.
Dedicated personal property staff up more than fivefold since 2017; Arizona training facility about to open; fourth Keys to Progress semi-truck awarded; employee and customer stories highlighted.
Reaffirmed core goal across cycles to grow as fast as possible while achieving at least a 96 CR (four cents of underwriting profit) and serving customers.

edited: 2026-11-26: four bullets corrected by hand against the letter (unstated causes and claims removed)
